### Bloomerang Pricing Overview (2026)

Bloomerang's pricing is **modular and scales with the number of contacts/records** (starting at ~1,000 contacts for published "starting at" rates). All plans include **unlimited users**, billed annually, with no free version or trial. Exact costs beyond entry-level require a sales quote. Pricing isn't per-user (despite some outdated Capterra listings claiming $119–$250/user/month—those are inaccurate).

#### Core Modules & Starting Prices
From official site [4] and reviews [1][2]:

| Module              | Starting Price (Annual Billing) | Key Features |
|---------------------|---------------------------------|--------------|
| **CRM**            | $125/month ($1,500/year)       | Donor profiles, retention analytics, reporting, email marketing, mobile app. |
| **Fundraising**    | $40/month ($480/year)          | Donation forms, events, peer-to-peer, text-to-give, auctions. *Requires CRM.* |
| **Volunteer**      | $119/month ($1,428/year)       | Scheduling, background checks, mobile app, donor sync. |
| **Membership**     | $25/month (add-on)             | Renewal automation, tracking. |
| **Giving Platform** (Full Bundle) | $524/month (~$6,288/year) | All modules integrated + automated journeys. |

- **Minimum for basics (CRM + Fundraising)**: $165/month ($1,980/year).
- **Full individual modules sum**: ~$284–$309/month ($3,408–$3,708/year), but bundle is higher at entry-level due to different scaling tiers [1].

#### Scaling & Hidden Costs
- **Contact-based tiers** (estimates from [1]; official beyond 1,000 requires sales call):
  
  | Contacts   | CRM Estimate | Full Suite Estimate | Annual Range |
  |------------|--------------|---------------------|--------------|
  | ~1,000    | $125/mo     | $524/mo            | $1,500–$6,288 |
  | ~2,500    | ~$175/mo    | Contact sales      | ~$2,100+    |
  | ~5,000    | ~$275/mo    | Contact sales      | ~$3,300+    |
  | ~10,000   | ~$425/mo    | Contact sales      | ~$5,100+    |
  | 20,000+   | Custom      | Custom             | Custom      |

- **Payment Processing** [1]:
  | Processor              | Rate          |
  |------------------------|---------------|
  | Bloomerang Payments   | 2.0% + $0.30 |
  | Stripe (nonprofit)    | 2.2% + $0.30 |
  | PayPal/Venmo          | 2.2% + $0.49 |

  Donors can cover fees. Competitive vs. standard rates.

- **Extras**: Implementation/migration fees, training/upsells [2][3]. No per-seat fees—strong for teams with volunteers/board.

#### Comparisons & Value
| Tool              | Starting Price | Scaling      | Unlimited Users | Notes |
|-------------------|----------------|--------------|-----------------|-------|
| **Bloomerang CRM**| $125/mo       | Contacts    | ✓              | Retention-focused; mid-sized nonprofits. |
| Little Green Light| $45/mo        | Contacts    | ✓              | Cheaper for small orgs. |
| Keela             | $134/mo       | Contacts    | ✓              | Similar entry. |
| Neon CRM          | $139/mo       | Revenue     | Unclear        | Growing orgs. |
| Zeffy             | Free          | N/A         | ✓              | Micro-nonprofits. |

**Verdict**: Entry CRM is $125–$300/mo for most small/medium nonprofits—**good value vs. enterprise tools** like Salesforce (per-seat fees add up) due to unlimited users and donor retention tools [1][2][3]. Bundle paradox: individual modules cheaper at low volumes, but scales custom. Get a quote for your contact count; consolidation often saves if replacing multiple tools. Reviews praise affordability for features [3].
